summary: Suzi performs a 300-pull summoning session on the Selected Summons banner targeting Ice Blast heroes. Throughout the session, she pulls several legendaries including Sagomir, Shinnah, and Donella. Upon reaching 300 total selectable summons, she claims Ernesto as her guaranteed selectable legendary hero to strengthen her Ice Blast team. She also demonstrates how to enter creator codes in the in-game Treasure Market.

heroes.name: Ernesto
heroes.note: Selected at 300 pulls on the banner over Fredegonda to build up her Ice Blast team.

heroes.name: Fredegonda
heroes.note: Available as a selectable legendary alongside Ernesto and Beldelle at 300 pulls.

heroes.name: Donella
heroes.note: Summoned during the pulls; noted for having niche utility.

heroes.name: Shinnah
heroes.note: Pulled during the Ice Blast banner summoning session.

heroes.name: Sagomir
heroes.note: Obtained as a legendary pull during the summon session.

tips: Always try to end your summoning session on a Legendary drop so you do not leave pulls invested in high pity.
Remember to re-link to your preferred creator code at the start of every month in the Treasure Market's Monthly tab to unlock bonus rewards.
title: I had to pull for ERNESTO!💥 Let's Summon! 🔥 Dragonheir x Dragonstride
